# Sophia Script for Windows The most advanced PowerShell module on GitHub for fine-tuning Windows Made with of Windows






## Key features * `Sophia Script for Windows` takes care of your Windows stability and warns you if it detects a problem * More than 150 unique functions to configure Windows using Microsoft's officially documented ways without harming the system * Every tweak has a corresponding function to restore the default settings * Fully open-source project * All archives are built and uploaded using [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/farag2/Sophia-Script-for-Windows/actions) * Configure Windows AI * Configure Windows privacy, security, and personalization * Available via Scoop, Chocolatey, and WinGet * Arm64 support * PowerShell 7 support * Compatible with [VAC](https://help.steampowered.com/faqs/view/571A-97DA-70E9-FF74#whatisvac) * Uninstall UWP apps showing their localized package names * The list of installed UWP apps is generated [dynamically](#screenshots) * Applied registry policies will be displayed in the Local Group Policy Editor snap-in (gpedit.msc) * Enable DNS-over-HTTPS using * [Cloudflare DNS](https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/setup/windows/) * [Google Public DNS](https://developers.google.com/speed/public-dns/docs/using) * [Quad9 DNS](https://quad9.net/service/service-addresses-and-features/) * [Comss.one DNS](https://www.comss.ru/page.php?id=7315) * [AdGuard DNS](https://adguard-dns.io/public-dns.html) * [OpenDNS](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/support/docs/security/umbrella/224705-configure-dns-over-https-doh-with.html) * Uninstall OneDrive * Interactive [prompts and pop-ups](#screenshots) * TAB [completion](#how-to-run-the-specific-functions) for functions and their arguments (using Import-TabCompletion.ps1) * Change the location of user folders (without moving user files) using an interactive menu * Desktop * Documents * Downloads * Music * Pictures * Videos * Install the free `Windows 11 Cursors Concept v2` cursors (light and dark) from [Jepri Creations](https://www.deviantart.com/jepricreations/art/Windows-11-Cursors-Concept-v2-886489356) on the fly * The archive is downloaded to the [Cursors](https://github.com/farag2/Sophia-Script-for-Windows/tree/main/Cursors) folder using the [DeviantArt API](https://github.com/farag2/Sophia-Script-for-Windows/blob/main/.github/workflows/Cursors.yml) * Set a default app for a specific file extension without the `How do you want to open this file?` pop-up * Export and import all Windows associations. To restore associations, install all apps listed in the exported JSON file first * Install a WSL Linux distribution via a [pop-up](#screenshots) using friendly distro names * Create scheduled tasks with a [native toast notification](#screenshots) * Create the `Windows Cleanup` and `Windows Cleanup Notification` scheduled tasks to clean up unused files and Windows Update files * Create the `SoftwareDistribution` scheduled task to clean up `%SystemRoot%\SoftwareDistribution\Download` * Create the `Temp` scheduled task to clean up temporary folders and files * `%SystemDrive%\$WinREAgent` * `%SystemDrive%\$SysReset` * `%SystemDrive%\$Windows.~WS` * `%SystemDrive%\$GetCurrent` * `%SystemDrive%\ESD` * `%SystemDrive%\Intel` * `%SystemDrive%\PerfLogs` * `%SystemRoot%\ServiceProfiles\NetworkService\AppData\Local\Temp` * `%LOCALAPPDATA%\CrashDumps` * `%SystemDrive%\Recovery` * `%SystemRoot%\System32\config\systemprofile\AppData\Local\tw-*.tmp` * Install the latest Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2026 x86/x64 * Install the latest .NET Desktop Runtime 8, 9, 10 x64 * Many more File Explorer and context menu tweaks ## Table of Contents * [Key features](#key-features) * [How to download](#how-to-download) * [Code signing policy](#code-signing-policy) * [How to use](#how-to-use) * [How to run the specific function(s)](#how-to-run-the-specific-functions) * [System Requirements](#system-requirements) * [Screenshots](#screenshots) * [How to translate](#how-to-translate) * [Media](#media) * [Acknowledgements](#acknowledgements) * [SophiApp 2.0](#sophiapp-20-c--winui-3) ## How to download ### From the release page
Windows 10 Windows 11
### Download via PowerShell Download the latest `Sophia Script for Windows` version for your Windows and PowerShell versions and extract it to the Downloads folder. ```powershell iwr script.sophia.team -useb | iex ``` Download the `Sophia Script for Windows` version from the latest [commit](https://github.com/farag2/Sophia-Script-for-Windows/commits/main/) for your Windows and PowerShell versions and extract it to the Downloads folder. ```powershell iwr sl.sophia.team -useb | iex ``` ### Chocolatey Download the latest `Sophia Script for Windows` version for your Windows version and extract it to the Downloads folder. ```powershell choco install sophia --force --yes ``` Download the latest PowerShell 7 version of `Sophia Script for Windows` for your Windows version and extract it to the Downloads folder. ```powershell choco install sophia --params "/PS7" --force --yes ``` ```powershell # Uninstall, then delete the downloaded folder manually choco uninstall sophia --force --yes ``` ### WinGet Download the latest `Sophia Script for Windows` version for Windows 11 and PowerShell 5.1 (SFX archive `sophiascript.exe`) and extract it to the Downloads folder. ```powershell $DownloadsFolder = Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path "HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\User Shell Folders" -Name "{374DE290-123F-4565-9164-39C4925E467B}" winget install --id TeamSophia.SophiaScript --location $DownloadsFolder --accept-source-agreements --force & "$DownloadsFolder\sophiascript.exe"; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; Remove-Item -Path "$DownloadsFolder\sophiascript.exe" -Force ``` ```powershell # Uninstall Sophia Script for Windows winget uninstall --id TeamSophia.SophiaScript --force ``` ### Scoop Download the latest `Sophia Script for Windows` version for Windows 11 and PowerShell 5.1 and extract it to the Downloads folder. ```powershell # scoop bucket rm extras scoop bucket add extras scoop install sophia-script --no-cache ``` ```powershell # scoop bucket rm versions scoop bucket add versions # sophia-script-ltsc2019, sophia-script-ltsc2021 # sophia-script-ltsc2024-ps7.json, sophia-script-ltsc2024 # sophia-script-ps7, sophia-script-win10-ps7 scoop install sophia-script-win10 --no-cache ``` ```powershell # Uninstall Sophia Script for Windows scoop uninstall sophia-script --purge ``` ## How to use * Download the archive for your system and extract it * Open `Sophia.ps1` and choose the functions you want to run * Put `#` before a function to skip it * Remove `#` before a function to run it * Copy the path to the extracted `Sophia Script for Windows` folder * Right-click the `Start` button, open Terminal (PowerShell) as administrator, and go to the copied folder ```powershell cd path\to\folder ``` * Allow running scripts in the current PowerShell session only ```powershell Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process -Force ``` * Type `.\Sophia.ps1` and press Enter ### How to run the specific function(s) * Follow the steps from [How to use](#how-to-use) up to and including setting the execution policy, but don't run `Sophia.ps1` * [Dot source](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/microsoft.powershell.core/about/about_operators#dot-sourcing-operator-) the `Import-TabCompletion.ps1` file first: ```powershell # With a dot at the beginning . .\Import-TabCompletion.ps1 ``` * Call any script function with name autocompletion using TAB ```powershell Sophia -Functions Sophia -Functions temp Sophia -Functions unin Sophia -Functions uwp Sophia -Functions "DiagTrackService -Disable", "DiagnosticDataLevel -Minimal", Uninstall-UWPApps Sophia -Functions Uninstall-UWPApps, "PinToStart -UnpinAll" ``` ## System Requirements [Windows-10]: https://support.microsoft.com/topic/windows-10-update-history-8127c2c6-6edf-4fdf-8b9f-0f7be1ef3562 [Windows-10-LTSC-2019]: https://support.microsoft.com/topic/windows-10-and-windows-server-2019-update-history-725fc2e1-4443-6831-a5ca-51ff5cbcb059 [Windows-10-LTSC-2021]: https://support.microsoft.com/topic/windows-10-update-history-857b8ccb-71e4-49e5-b3f6-7073197d98fb [Windows-11-LTSC-2024]: https://support.microsoft.com/topic/windows-11-version-24h2-update-history-0929c747-1815-4543-8461-0160d16f15e5 [Windows-11-25h2]: https://support.microsoft.com/topic/windows-11-version-25h2-update-history-99c7f493-df2a-4832-bd2d-6706baa0dec0 | Version | Build | Edition | |:-----------------------------------------|:-------------------------------------:|:-------------------:| | Windows 11 25H2+ | [Latest stable][Windows-11-25h2] | Home/Pro/Enterprise | | Windows 10 x64 22H2 | [Latest stable][Windows-10] | Home/Pro/Enterprise | | Windows 11 Enterprise LTSC 2024 | [Latest stable][Windows-11-LTSC-2024] | Enterprise | | Windows 10 21H2 Enterprise LTSC 2021 | [Latest stable][Windows-10-LTSC-2021] | Enterprise | | Windows 10 x64 1809 Enterprise LTSC 2019 | [Latest stable][Windows-10-LTSC-2019] | Enterprise | ## Screenshots

## How to translate * Run `$PSUICulture` in PowerShell to determine your UI language * Create a folder with the UI language name (e.g. `en-US`) * Put your localized `SophiaScript.psd1` file into this folder ## Media
